about.background: I'm based in the Philippines and graduated with a BS in Information Technology from Mindanao State University – Iligan Institute of Technology (MSU-IIT) in July 2026.
about.availability: I'm currently working at BKMElevations LLC, a startup based in New York, United States, as a full-stack developer and GoHighLevel (GHL) integrator. I joined in September 2026 and work on its client project, Legacy Rides.
about.skills: My skills include TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Motoko, React, Next.js, React Native, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Laravel, Node.js, MongoDB, Solana, Internet Computer Protocol (ICP), GoHighLevel (GHL) integration, and self-hosted n8n automation. I also work with Git, Vercel, and Resend.
